description: This file implements PagerDuty alerting integration for monitoring high failure rates and hanging requests in a system, with logic for threshold-based alerting and event management.

classes.name: PagerDutyAlerting
classes.description: A class that extends SlackAlerting to provide PagerDuty alerting for failed and hanging requests, with threshold-based alerting logic.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event
methods.description: Records a failure event and triggers an alert if failure threshold is exceeded within a time window.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook
methods.description: Pre-call hook to detect hanging requests by scheduling a response handler.

methods.name: hanging_response_handler
methods.description: Checks if a request has hung by waiting for a threshold and then recording a hanging event if not completed.

methods.name: _send_alert_if_thresholds_crossed
methods.description: Prunes old events, checks if threshold is crossed, and sends alert if necessary.

methods.name: _build_error_summaries
methods.description: Creates short summaries of recent error events for alert details.

methods.name: send_alert_to_pagerduty
methods.description: Sends an alert message to PagerDuty via HTTP API.
